_comment: Miniature bundles.json for install-selection tests. Deliberately tiny and platform-neutral so expectations in cases.json stay readable and stable; the real catalog has 271 skills and would make every expectation a maintenance burden. Shape mirrors data/bundles.json (metadata / profiles / modules / bundles) plus the two optional objects the v3.16.1 contract defines (skill_dependencies, surface_requirements). The `_available_*` keys are test-only and stand in for what exists on disk under catalog/.

metadata.description: Fixture catalog for install-selection contract tests.

_profile_shape_note: Profiles COMPOSE from bundles + modules + extra_skills and carry no flat `skills` list, mirroring the real data/bundles.json exactly. A resolver that reads only `skills` resolves every real profile to the empty set. `full` is marked by `all: true`, not by listing the catalog.

profiles.name: Minimal
profiles.description: Smallest coherent set: one role bundle.

profiles.name: Core
profiles.description: A bundle plus a module plus one extra skill, exercising all three composition keys at once.

profiles.name: Full
profiles.description: Everything in the catalog. Equivalent to the no-selector default install.

profiles.name: Empty
profiles.description: Test-only profile that composes from nothing, to exercise the empty-selection error.

bundles.name: Alpha
bundles.description: Role bundle with no dependency edges.

bundles.name: Beta
bundles.description: Role bundle whose dep1 pulls dep2 through closure.
